definitions.name: Doomed
definitions.description: A fate that courts disaster — calamity shadows every step, and fortune slips through the fingers like mist.

definitions.name: Ill-Fated
definitions.description: Bad omens follow wherever they walk; promising doors tend to close just before they arrive.

definitions.name: Mundane
definitions.description: A common lot shared by most cultivators — no special favor, no unusual curse, just the long road ahead.

definitions.name: Favored
definitions.description: The heavens seem to smile on their path — lucky encounters and useful opportunities appear with pleasing regularity.

definitions.name: Blessed
definitions.description: Fortune bends toward them like a loyal servant; hidden treasures and rare teachers find their way to their door.

definitions.name: Heavenly-Favored
definitions.description: The will of heaven itself seems to arrange the world around them — calamities veer away and opportunities abound.

definitions.name: Son of Heaven
definitions.description: A destiny as vast as the sky — the heavens themselves conspire on their behalf, and calamity dare not touch them.
